problems.why: Finding 4 is about the all-years chart, but it complains of too many colours and stripes, which is close to the opposite of the person's point that everything is grey and nothing stands out; finding 1 is about grey text, not the graph.

No finding says the year graph is all grey so nothing stands out; finding 4 actually complains about too many colours in that chart, and finding 1 is about small grey text being hard to read, not about a lack of contrast that would make something stand out.
